text:
deploybot: [PRE-FLIGHT] Planned Dedicated deploy for tenant Marisol scheduled 2026-04-12 01:30 UTC.
Model artifact: open-redwood/kaiju-13b@v1.7.0 (candidate). Suggest pin: redwood-v1.7.0-quant-lite. Commit: b4c9d2.
Canary proposal: 2% -> 10% -> 30% -> 100% with 15m shadowing on full traffic.
Rollback triggers: p95 latency increase >300ms OR request error-rate delta >1% OR quality checks failing (>2% QA prompt mismatch).
Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/marisol-dedicated-2026-04 || Release notes: https://docs.redwood.ai/releases/v1.7.0
Please ack or raise immediate blockers. :mag:

maria: acking but product asks we pin to redwood-v1.7.0-quant-lite (we saw consistent token quality on our eval set). Add note to release notes about slight tokenization diffs on long inputs.

jon: infra heads-up 1: there's a planned maintenance window for one of the eu-west-2 nodes at 2026-04-12 02:00 UTC (non-disruptive usually). Might affect post-deploy validation (02:15 smoke). Can we shift smoke to 02:40 or set validation to run against healthy slice?

anya: from SRE perf tests: baseline p95 ~180ms on prod-like slice. Quant-lite increases mean by ~25ms but p95 is stable. Recommend first canary step be 1% for 20m instead of 2% for safety, and enable request shadowing for 20m to compare outputs. Also enable healthcheck endpoint /svc/marisol/ready.

sec: security note 1: HSM firmware update scheduled for 2026-04-12 03:00 UTC for eu-west keys. It won't touch tenant keys, but if you want us to block it for Marisol I can toggle. Also ensure KMS key rotation isn't colliding with release.

oncall: I'll cover the window. We can roll back to previous model within ~7m. Need explicit rollback command in the runbook top-level and a short smoke checklist. I'll add myself to the pager for the window.

nate: devex request 1: please tag release with `release/marisol/1.7.0-ql` and add canary labels in metrics so we can slice dashboards by canary_pct. I'll also push a small synthetic traffic job for 15m during the 10% step.

maria: decision: pin -> redwood-v1.7.0-quant-lite, disable autoscaling for 40m (canary window), first step 1% for 20m, then 10% for 15m, 30% for 15m, then 100% after manual verify. Require shadowing for full first two steps and healthcheck gate.
Config to apply during canary:
```
PATCH /tenants/marisol/config
{
  "model_version": "redwood-v1.7.0-quant-lite",
  "autoscaling": { "enabled": false, "resume_after_min": 40 },
  "canary": { "steps": [1, 10, 30, 100], "durations_min": [20, 15, 15, 0], "shadow_minutes": 20 },
  "health_probe": "/svc/marisol/ready"
}
```

jon: confirmed 1 I'll ensure maintenance won't impact the slices used for validation; will pin nodes if needed.

anya: adding alerts:
incidents.create("marisol-serving-p95", threshold_ms=300, window_min=5)
incidents.create("marisol-error-delta", pct=1.0, window_min=5)
Also adding an eval job comparing 200 smoke prompts every step; fail if >2% mismatch.

sec: HSM update postponed for Marisol key. KMS rotation untouched but noted. :lock:

oncall: created short channel #deploy-marisol-2026-04-12 and added oncall. I'll post live updates there during window.

nate: synthetic load job scheduled to run at 01:55 UTC against the canary slice for 15m during the 10% step. Dashboard widgets updated.

maria: final: GO for 2026-04-12 01:30 UTC with the above constraints. @oncall monitor latency, errors, and eval snapshot; @jon standby for node pinning; @sec hold HSM.

deploybot: Schedule set: 2026-04-12 01:30 UTC, model pinned to redwood-v1.7.0-quant-lite, initial canary 1%. Runbook pinned and release tagged release/marisol/1.7.0-ql. Status: SCHEDULED.

oncall: standing by. If any alert fires we'll execute rollback and post the steps we performed.

deploybot: [ACTION] Rollback command (if triggered): `deployctl rollback --tenant marisol --to-commit a1f7c3`

maria: thanks all 1 I'll update the tenant ticket with the QA snapshot after rollout. Closing thread.
